title: Hundreds and thousands
description: Count to a million, and split things in halves and dozens.
grammar: the hundreds, the thousands, and the words around numbers
grammarNote: Cien becomes cientos inside a bigger number, and mil never takes an -s.

explanation.summary: Eighty and ninety close the tens, and then come the hundreds and the thousands. A few small words around numbers — half, a dozen, even and odd — finish the system, and after this unit there is no number from zero to a million you cannot say.

sections.heading: Eighty and above
sections.body: Ochenta and noventa work like the other tens. Cien is a hundred on its own, and doscientos and quinientos are two and five hundred. Mil is a thousand and never takes an -s, and un millón is a million.

sections.heading: Around the numbers
sections.body: Medio is half, and una docena is twelve of something. Par is even and impar is odd. None of them change, and they go where any other number goes.

items.note: Masculine: un millón. The accent marks the stress.
Half: medio. The feminine is media.

drills.meaning: I want half a kilo of apples
